messages:
sam.t: Heads-up — CI started failing on the kernel build job after we merged the attention-optimizations RFC. Oddly looks like nvcc/gencode churn and PTX variants exploded the fatbin size.
alex.j: Repro? can you paste the nvcc line and cuobjdump output?
sam.t: pasted the build log into Gist: https://gist.github.com/xxxx
sam.t: nvcc flags we used: `nvcc -O3 -std=c++14 --gencode=arch=compute_70,code=sm_70 --gencode=arch=compute_80,code=sm_80 --gencode=arch=compute_86,code=sm_86 -Xfatbin=mc`
sam.t: cuobjdump shows multiple PTX blobs per sm, and a ~65% binary size increase vs master.
maria: Oof. Did the RFC add extra template-specialized kernels that forced separate cubin/ptx for each sm?
sam.t: Yep — the new fused-attn kernels have per-sm tuning tables. We tried to be safe and emit PTX for all target arches.
kai: Quick thought: emitting PTX for _all_ archs is safe for compatibility but kills artifacts. Could we instead emit PTX only for a minimal compatibility set and rely on kernel fallbacks for others?
alex.j: Agreed. For CI we should curate a small arch whitelist that matches our CI hardware and the ones we ship in Dedicated. Add a size-gate to catch regressions.
maria: Size gate + artifact diff. Example check: `du -b build/*.fatbin | sort -nr | head -n 5` and `cuobjdump --list mymodule.fatbin` in the CI step. If size_delta > 15% fail the job.
ci-bot: Build #7421: kernel-build passed on linux-x86-64 (nvcc12). artifact-size: 46.2MB -> baseline 27.8MB (+66%). See build artifacts.
lee: Another lever is to switch some generated PTX to assembly-only (.cubin) for sm targets we actually test. That reduces PTX text but loses forward compatibility when new drivers want JIT. Tradeoff: smaller CI artifacts vs runtime portability.
kai: Also check `-Xptxas=-v` warnings; register pressure or lto options can bloat code. Try `-Xcompiler -fno-exceptions` for host side or `-arch` vs `--gencode` simplification.
alex.j: Action items: 1) temporary CI whitelist: sm_70, sm_80; 2) size-gate at 25% growth; 3) a follow-up RFC to expose per-target emission controls in our build system; 4) add a cuobjdump summary to CI logs.
sam.t: I'll open PR to change the CMake nvcc wrapper to use a curated arch list and add the size check.
maria: Ping me on the PR, I can add the CI YAML. Also we should add a note to the RFC follow-up about runtime fallback policy when PTX is omitted.
lee: One more gotcha — different CUDA toolkit versions accept different ptx versions. If we shrink PTX set we must ensure the shipped cubins are compatible across our supported driver matrix.
aiops-bot: NOTE: Recommend gating the artifact upload for Dedicated images until manual approval if size regressed > 50%.
sam.t: Cool. I'll prototype smaller whitelist and run a few builds overnight. Thanks all :thumbsup:
